annotations.title: List surf spots near a place

description: Use this when the person asks what surf spots are around a place or around them. Give near (a town, area or spot name) or lat and lon. Not for where the surf is best: use find_best_surf. Answers the nearest surf spots to a spot, town or area named in near, or to lat and lon: each with its distance in km, kind and which way it faces; at most 40.

near.description: a town, a coast or a spot: Lisbon, Hossegor, Supertubos
